remarks: Welcome to this inviting 4-bedroom, 2.1-bath single-family home offering comfort, space, and convenience in a sought-after location. The thoughtfully designed floor plan features a desirable first-floor primary suite with an adjoining office, ideal for today's work-from-home lifestyle. Enjoy gatherings in the bright living room with a cozy fireplace or relax in the expansive sun room overlooking the spacious yard. The home's outdoor amenities are equally impressive, including a brand-new composite deck, covered grilling area, and flagstone patio -ideal for entertaining or weekend relaxation. Additional highlights include hardwood floors throughout, a whole-house generator for peace of mind, and excellent proximity to schools, shopping, I-95, and the commuter rail. With just a touch of updating, this home offers tremendous potential to make it truly your own.
